props.name: size
props.description: Scales the track and thumb together.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The uncontrolled value of the slider when it's initially rendered. To render a controlled slider, use the `value` prop instead.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the slider should ignore user interaction.

props.name: form
props.description: Identifies the form that owns the slider inputs. Useful when the slider is rendered outside the form.

props.name: format
props.description: Options to format the value.

props.name: largeStep
props.description: The granularity with which the slider can step through values when using Page Up/Page Down or Shift + Arrow Up/Arrow Down.

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale used by `Intl.NumberFormat` when formatting the value. Defaults to the user's runtime locale.

props.name: max
props.description: The maximum allowed value of the slider. Should not be equal to min.

props.name: min
props.description: The minimum allowed value of the slider. Should not be equal to max.

props.name: minStepsBetweenValues
props.description: The minimum steps between values in a range slider.

props.name: name
props.description: Identifies the field when a form is submitted.

props.name: onValueChange
props.type: (value: number | readonly number[], eventDetails: SliderRootChangeEventDetails) => void
props.description: Callback function that is fired when the slider's value changed. Receives the new value as the first argument; the originating event is available as `eventDetails.event`. The value is also reflected on `eventDetails.event.target.value` for form integration. The `eventDetails.reason` indicates what triggered the change: - `'input-change'` when the hidden range input emits a change event (for example, via form integration) - `'track-press'` when the control track is pressed - `'drag'` while dragging a thumb - `'keyboard'` for keyboard input - `'none'` when the change is triggered without a specific interaction

props.name: onValueCommitted
props.type: (value: number | readonly number[], eventDetails: SliderRootCommitEventDetails) => void
props.description: Callback function that is fired when a value change is committed. Does not fire if the value did not change, or if the change was canceled. **Warning**: This is a generic event, not a change event. The `eventDetails.reason` indicates what triggered the commit: - `'drag'` while dragging a thumb - `'track-press'` when the control track is pressed - `'keyboard'` for keyboard input - `'input-change'` when the hidden range input emits a change event (for example, via form integration) - `'none'` when the commit occurs without a specific interaction

props.name: orientation
props.description: The component orientation.

props.name: step
props.description: The granularity with which the slider can step through values. (A "discrete" slider.) The `min` prop serves as the origin for the valid values. We recommend (max - min) to be evenly divisible by the step.

props.name: thumbAlignment
props.description: How the thumb(s) are aligned relative to `Slider.Control` when the value is at `min` or `max`: - `center`: The center of the thumb is aligned with the control edge - `edge`: The thumb is inset within the control such that its edge is aligned with the control edge - `edge-client-only`: Same as `edge` but renders after React hydration on the client, reducing bundle size in return

props.name: thumbCollisionBehavior
props.description: Controls how thumbs behave when they collide during pointer interactions. - `'push'` (default): Thumbs push each other without restoring their previous positions when dragged back. - `'swap'`: Thumbs swap places when dragged past each other. - `'none'`: Thumbs cannot move past each other; excess movement is ignored.

props.name: value
props.description: The value of the slider. For range sliders, provide an array with one value per thumb.

props.name: aria-valuetext
props.description: A string value forwarded to the [`aria-valuetext`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Reference/Attributes/aria-valuetext) attribute of the `input`. Ignored when `getAriaValueText` is provided.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the thumb should ignore user interaction.

props.name: getAriaLabel
props.description: A function which returns a string value for the [`aria-label`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Reference/Attributes/aria-label) attribute of the `input`.

props.name: getAriaValueText
props.type: ((formattedValue: string, value: number, index: number) => string) | null
props.description: A function which returns a string value for the [`aria-valuetext`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Reference/Attributes/aria-valuetext) attribute of the `input`. This is important for screen reader users.

props.name: index
props.description: The index of the thumb which corresponds to the index of its value in the `value` or `defaultValue` array. This prop is required to support server-side rendering for range sliders with multiple thumbs.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: A ref to access the nested input element.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: A blur handler forwarded to the `input`.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: A focus handler forwarded to the `input`.

props.name: onKeyDown
props.description: A keydown handler forwarded to the `input`.

props.name: tabIndex
props.description: Optional tab index attribute forwarded to the `input`.

props.name: count
props.description: Number of evenly spaced marks, including both ends.
